description: crystallize(chunk): the shdccp/2 crystal packet of one chunk (RFC 07 section 5), with 0x80 crystal bytes in each of the four slots. The raw rule is normative; informative.kernel_normalized_packet shows the packet under the kernel normalisation (code -128 written as -127), which shdccp/2 does not use.

cases.note: the long-standing cross-language golden; it has no 0x80 crystal byte
